# Individual Contributor License Agreement

Thank you for contributing to kernable. This agreement makes clear which rights you grant with
your contributions, so that kernable can keep developing, distributing and licensing the project,
and so that you and every user are protected. You keep the copyright in your contributions; this
agreement only grants a license to use them.

You accept this agreement by posting the following sentence, unchanged, as a comment on your first
pull request when the CLA check asks you to; the check keeps a record of it:

> I have read the kernable Individual Contributor License Agreement in .github/CLA.md and I agree
> to it for all my contributions to kernable.

It then applies to all your contributions to the project, past and future.

## 1. Definitions

- **"kernable"** means the business kernable, proprietor Artur Susdorf, and any legal successor or

- **"You"** means the individual who accepts this agreement.
- **"Contribution"** means any original work of authorship, including any change or addition to

  or managed by kernable (the "Work"). "Submit" means any form of electronic, verbal or written

  and comments, but not communication that You conspicuously mark as "Not a Contribution".

You are not expected to provide support for Your Contributions, except to the extent You want

## 6. Work of others

Should You wish to submit work that is not Your original creation, You may submit it to kernable

## 7. Open source availability

kernable will make each Contribution it includes in the Work available under the open source

To the extent permitted by applicable law, You agree not to assert any moral rights in Your
